key.name: music-card-enabled
key.description: Show the macOS Tahoe-style Now Playing card in Quick Settings.

key.name: show-battery-pill
key.description: Show the stock battery percentage pill (P2 feature).

key.name: fetch-remote-art
key.description: Allow fetching album art over HTTPS for the Now Playing card.

key.name: layout-json
key.description: Empty string uses the default layout. Provide a JSON object with a "blocks" array to override. Invalid JSON falls back to the default with a warning logged.

key.name: debug
key.description: Enable verbose logging and actor tree dump on enable(). Never enable in production.
